english.title: Unlawfully release cattle or destroy or damage cattle pound or place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[released cattle from]_
(B)_[attempted to release cattle from]_
(C)_[pulled down, damaged or destroyed]_
(D)_[pulled down, damaged or destroyed part of]_

a pound or place where

(E)_[they]_
(F)_[cattle]_

were impounded under the authority of

(G)_[the Town Police Clauses Act 1847]_
(H)_[**(..SPECIFY LOCAL ACT..) incorporated with the Town Police Clauses Act 1847]_

with intent to procure the unlawful release of such cattle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 26 of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847.
english.pointstoprove:
date andlocation

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The word "cattle" shall include horses, asses, mules, sheep, goats, and swine - Section 3 of the Act

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/ or a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale and not be of such an amount as wouldsubject the offender, in default of payment of the fine, to a longer term ofimprisonment or detention than the term to which he is liable on conviction ofthe offence.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

libra.complexpenaltydetails: 3 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale and not an amount as would subject the offender, in default of payment, to a longer term of imprisonment/detention than the term to which he is liable on conviction.
